vael_intro.speaker: vael
vael_intro.text: Archmage! Please, look at the Solari Sun-Vine in conservatory bed four! The graft with our native starlight briar took beautifully for three seasons, but since the morning watch, the golden blossoms are turning black and brittle.

start_quest.title: The Golden Graft
start_quest.desc: Heal a dying celestial flora hybrid in the starlight glasshouses.
stages: Examine the withered Solari sun-vine in the botanical terrace
Identify the necrotic blight affecting the starlight rootstock
Synthesize a nutrient infusion using star-water

choices.text: [Acumen Check] The graft isn't sick with blight—it's essence starvation. The soil conduits are clogged with calcified mineral deposits from the upper aqueduct.
[Arcana Check] Let me weave an invigorating light-stream through the xylem vascular bundle.
What nutrients have you been feeding the hybrid rootstock?

vael_explain.speaker: vael
vael_explain.text: Standard star-water mixed with crushed amber moss. But ever since the harmonic tremor, the roots have refused to drink.

choices.text: We need to clear the root channels and restore harmonic flow.

vael_acumen_pass.speaker: vael
vael_acumen_pass.text: Mineral clogging! Of course! The Terran masonry work upstream kicked calcium flakes into the feeder lines. Let us flush the irrigation tubes immediately.

choices.text: Flush the conduits with purified star-water.

vael_acumen_fail.speaker: vael
vael_acumen_fail.text: The leaves are wilting faster. If the main stem snaps, two decades of hybrid cultivation will be lost.

choices.text: Prune the damaged runners and brace the central stalk.

vael_arcana_pass.speaker: vael
vael_arcana_pass.text: The golden glow is returning to the veins! The petals are unfurling again, drinking in the light.

choices.text: Stabilize the harmonic frequency at fifty-four hertz.

vael_action.speaker: vael
vael_action.text: Help me aerate the soil while you channel warmth into the root collar.

choices.text: Channel steady warmth into the soil bed.

vael_resolve.speaker: vael
vael_resolve.text: Look! A fresh golden shoot is already budding at the crown. You saved the hybrid, Archmage. Sylvari gardens throughout the terrace will flourish tonight.
